Adds DeepInfra model provider support to OpenClaw.

## Distribution

- Package: `@openclaw/deepinfra-provider`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `clawhub:@openclaw/deepinfra-provider`

## Surface

- Providers: `deepinfra`
- Contracts: `embeddingProviders`, `imageGenerationProviders`, `mediaUnderstandingProviders`, `speechProviders`, `videoGenerationProviders`
